stock_uncle_insight.date_header: 9/19 法人與主力大戶主要買超股票

buyer_groups.group_title: 1. 外資大戶：狂掃記憶體與晶圓代工，面板金融遭倒貨

stocks.description: 肖年仔，外資狂掃力積電七萬七千多張，這不是黑白買，是看好記憶體底部翻揚的訊號啦！高盛也來參一咖，這波有戲。
外資也沒放過華邦電，四萬兩千多張直接買進，跟力積電一樣，都是記憶體族群，準備要點火了。
南亞科也買超三萬兩千多張，記憶體三劍客外資都進場了，這波是真外資在卡位，不是短線仔。
聯電買超兩萬八千多張，晶圓代工二哥被外資看上，這不只是低基期，可能還有訂單回溫的預期。
封測廠京元電外資買超兩萬一千多張，半導體下游也開始動了，這波是整個產業鏈在轉骨。
南茂外資也買超一萬三千多張，跟京元電一樣，都是封測廠，外資在半導體產業鏈的布局很全面。
矽格外資買超一萬三千多張，半導體封測股被外資鎖碼，這表示他們看好後續的訂單動能。
旺宏外資買超九千八百多張，記憶體族群全面開花，外資這波是鐵了心要拉抬。
外資買超元大金九千多張，金融股在市場震盪時，常常是資金的避風港，外資在找防禦性標的。
中華電也買超七千四百多張，這種電信股就是穩，外資在市場不確定時，會把錢放在這種定存概念股。

buyer_groups.group_title: 2. 投信大戶（本土國家隊）：作帳行情啟動，半導體與AI伺服器雙管齊下

stocks.description: 投信買超聯電一萬三千多張，跟外資英雄所見略同，這檔低基期晶圓代工，投信也準備要作帳了。
長榮航投信買超九千兩百多張，外資在賣，投信卻在買，這可能是投信看好解封後的旺季效應，準備拉高出貨給肖年仔。
藥華藥買超八千五百多張，生技股的明星，投信在找有題材、有成長性的標的，這檔就是代表。
廣達買超五千一百多張，AI伺服器概念股，投信這是在卡位AI長線趨勢，雖然漲高了，但還是有資金追捧。
興富發買超四千一百多張，營建股在市場震盪時，有時候會被當作避險標的，或是特定基金的配置需求。
南亞科投信也買超三千九百多張，記憶體族群不只外資，連本土國家隊也進場，這波是真的有共識。
力積電投信買超三千八百多張，記憶體雙雄都上榜，投信跟外資同步買超，這訊號很強。
友達投信買超三千六百多張，外資狂倒，投信卻接刀，這可能是投信看好面板報價落底，或是為了作帳拉抬。
緯創買超三千多張，AI伺服器雙雄，投信還是持續布局，這塊餅還很大，肖年仔別亂割韭菜。
寶成投信買超三千多張，傳產股的龍頭，投信在找穩健的標的，這檔有機會被當作防禦性配置。

buyer_groups.group_title: 3. 內資主力與實戶：避險兼短打，ETF與低價股齊飛

stocks.description: 自營商狂買0050一萬一千多張，這就是標準的避險盤，市場不確定性高，先買ETF避風頭，或是做權證對沖。
力積電自營商也買超四千八百多張，三大法人同步買超，這檔記憶體股的籌碼很漂亮，肖年仔可以注意。
益航買超三千一百多張，這種低價股常常是內資主力短打的目標，拉高出貨給散戶，肖年仔別黑白追。
華邦電自營商買超三千多張，記憶體族群被三大法人看上，這波反彈的力道不容小覷。
友達自營商買超兩千八百多張，外資狂賣，投信、自營商卻在接，這檔面板股的籌碼很混亂，小心接刀。
聯電自營商買超兩千四百多張，三大法人同步買超，這檔晶圓代工二哥，是真的有機會。
京元電自營商買超兩千多張，半導體封測也動起來了，內資主力也跟著法人腳步進場。
南茂自營商買超一千六百多張，封測族群被內資主力看上，這波是整個半導體鏈在動。
農林買超一千五百多張，這種資產股或低價股，常常是內資主力在炒作，小心被割韭菜。
中電買超一千兩百多張，跟農林一樣，都是內資主力愛玩的低價股，短線波動大，風險也高。

strategies.strategy_title: 策略一：記憶體與晶圓代工低基期卡位，迎接產業復甦
strategies.strategy_content: 外資、投信、自營商三大法人同步大買力積電、華邦電、南亞科等記憶體股，以及聯電、京元電子等晶圓代工與封測股。這擺明是看好半導體產業庫存調整接近尾聲，記憶體報價有機會止跌回升，晶圓代工訂單也可能逐步回溫。肖年仔，這不是黑白買，這是主力在底部卡位，準備迎接產業春燕。

strategies.strategy_title: 策略二：AI基礎建設題材點火，長線布局伺服器與光通訊
strategies.strategy_content: 投信持續買超廣達、緯創等AI伺服器概念股，雖然國際新聞提到Corning的光纖大單是美股，但這代表AI基礎建設的需求是全球性的。台灣在AI供應鏈扮演關鍵角色，主力資金持續鎖碼這些AI相關標的，是看好AI長線趨勢，準備波段操作。

strategies.strategy_title: 策略三：資金避風港與作帳行情，防禦性與特定題材並重
strategies.strategy_content: 外資買超元大金、中華電等金融電信股，自營商大買元大台灣50（0050），這都是市場震盪時的避險操作。同時，投信在金融股大舉結帳後，轉進長榮航、藥華藥、興富發等有特定題材或作帳需求的股票。這顯示主力資金在尋求防禦性的同時，也不放過有機會拉抬的標的，準備在年底前衝一波績效。

stock_uncle_insight.summary: 肖年仔，今天三大法人對半導體記憶體與晶圓代工是真愛，狂掃低基期股準備點火，AI伺服器也持續鎖碼。但面板跟部分金融股被外資倒貨，投信則在金融股結帳後轉進作帳股，自營商則是ETF避險兼短打低價股。市場資金輪動快速，別黑白追高，小心被割韭菜！

top_brokerages_analysis.uncle_logic: 高盛這個外資大戶，狂掃力積電兩萬七千多張，這不是短線仔在玩，是真外資看好記憶體產業底部翻揚，準備波段鎖碼，肖年仔可以跟著吃豆腐。
凱基台北這個隔日沖大戶，買超0050四千多張，這通常是兩種情況：一是市場不確定性高，先買ETF避險，隔天再看情況倒貨；二是做權證避險盤，肖年仔別以為是波段，小心被割韭菜。
元大投信自家買聯電六千多張，這很明顯是投信在作帳，把自家基金的錢灌進去，準備拉抬績效，肖年仔可以觀察，但別追高。
摩根大通這個外資大戶，對友達狂倒貨一萬五千多張，這跟外資整體賣超面板的趨勢一致，擺明是不看好面板短線，肖年仔別亂接刀，小心被套牢。

english_professor_news.title: This Is The Very Best Week Of The Year To Buy A House
english_professor_news.level1_blind:
The week spanning September 27 through October 3 is historically the best time to buy a home, with inventory up 32% and 5.7% of listings seeing price reductions.

High mortgage rates around 6.7% have thinned buyer competition, giving remaining buyers more negotiating power against motivated sellers.

A K-shaped housing market is emerging: sub-$300K home sales fell 10% this year while million-dollar listings held steady.

Read More: Learn 7 secret wealth tips high net worth investors use that most investors miss (sponsor)

If you can afford it, the best week of the year to buy a house is from September 27 to October 3. This, of course, depends on whether you can pay cash or take on a 6.7% fixed-rate, 30-year mortgage. Many people can't, which has triggered a major slowdown in housing sales.

"Historically, this week offers the most favorable balance of market conditions for buyers. Inventory tends to be elevated, prices typically dip below their seasonal peak, buyer competition slows, and the overall pace of the market becomes more manageable," Realtor.com reports. Of course, for some sellers, it could signal desperation. Summer is a good time to sell a house in most parts of the country. For sellers who didn't have luck, it could be a time to reprice and negotiate.

Supply and demand numbers compare favorably to the start of the year for home buyers. In most years, inventory is up 31.9% compared to the start of the year.

The real estate research firm says that this week, the number of buyers in the market has dipped compared to most weeks. It is simple supply and demand. High interest rates may have driven those buyers out of the market. In that case, the current situation could continue. Additionally, evidence suggests sellers have modestly dropped prices from their average of $416,000, which is near a record.

english_professor_news.title: Assemblin Caverion prints €1.5B floating-rate note in bumper day for European high yield

level1_blind.text:
Assemblin Caverion on Sept. 16 priced the second-largest euro-denominated floating-rate note (FRN) ever sold by a European high yield borrower, after the Stockholm-based technical installations group upsized its planned seven-year deal to €1.53 billion.

The bumper deal — which cleared at E+300, offered at par — is the largest euro FRN tranche since Wind Tre's record-breaking €2.25 billion deal back in 2017. It tops a €1.375 billion Nexi bond from 2018 and a €1.25 billion trade from TeamSystem last year.

Big slateAssemblin Caverion's offering was also the largest in a €4.53 billion slate of high yield transactions to price on Sept. 16 — which according to LCD, represents the busiest day of the year so far in volume terms for the European primary high yield market, and the sixth-busiest on record.

The mammoth size of the new offering for Assemblin Caverion mainly reflects the fact that the group is effectively merging a higher-cost €780 million E+350 FRN into the new tranche, a strategy commonly used by high yield borrowers whose existing debt is already callable.

The deal, originally sized at €750 million, nevertheless reflects strong demand for floating-rate paper from an issuer that already has both fixed- and floating-rate debt in its structure.

"We were surprised seeing FRNs only, but it is the environment we prefer as an investor," said a manager at a high yield bond fund. He also said the fund has increased its allocation to floating-rate debt from 15% to about 20% in recent weeks, and plans to increase this allocation to roughly a quarter of the portfolio.

FRN buyersThe creation of new European CLOs — the core buyers of high yield FRNs — has meanwhile remained robust this year, with new issuance running roughly in line with 2025's record volumes and new managers entering the market. While the number of warehouses open at any given time is difficult to quantify, speakers at S&P Global's European Structured Finance Conference in September put the number at 200.

Assemblin Caverion was formed in 2024 after Triton merged its technical installations company Assemblin with Caverion, the Finnish construction systems group which the private equity firm took private the prior year for €1.12 billion. The bond deal will support a dividend to Triton.

level2_keywords.meaning: 浮動利率債券，這是一種利率會隨著市場基準利率（例如歐洲銀行同業拆款利率Euribor）變動的債券，與固定利率債券不同，它能幫助投資者在利率上升時獲得更高的收益。
level2_keywords.example: Many investors prefer floating-rate notes in an environment of rising interest rates to protect their returns.

level2_keywords.meaning: 高收益債券發行者，通常指信用評級較低、違約風險較高，因此必須提供較高利率才能吸引投資者的公司或實體。這類債券在台灣常被稱為『垃圾債券』，但財經界更常用『高收益債券』。
level2_keywords.example: As a high yield borrower, the company had to offer attractive interest rates to secure funding for its expansion.

level2_keywords.meaning: 債券批次或部分，指一項金融交易中被劃分為不同部分或層級的證券，每個批次可能有不同的風險、利率或到期日。
level2_keywords.example: The new bond offering was split into several tranches to cater to different investor appetites.

level2_keywords.meaning: 可提前贖回債務，指發行公司有權在債券到期前，按照特定條款將債券買回（贖回）的債務。這通常在利率下降時對發行者有利，因為他們可以發行新債來取代舊債，降低融資成本。
level2_keywords.example: The company decided to refinance its callable debt when market interest rates dropped significantly.

level2_keywords.meaning: 擔保貸款憑證，這是一種將多筆企業貸款打包成證券，再依風險和收益分成不同層級（tranches）出售給投資者的金融產品。它們是高收益浮動利率債券的重要買家。
level2_keywords.example: The robust creation of new European CLOs has fueled demand for high yield floating-rate notes.

english_professor_news.level2_context: 各位同學，這篇新聞報導的是歐洲高收益債券市場的一件大事。瑞典的技術安裝集團Assemblin Caverion發行了一筆高達15.3億歐元的浮動利率債券（FRN），這不僅是歐洲高收益市場有史以來第二大的歐元計價浮動利率債券，也創下了今年歐洲高收益債券發行量單日新高。這背後反映了幾個重要的財經趨勢：首先，在當前利率環境下，浮動利率債券對投資者來說更具吸引力，因為它們的收益會隨市場利率上升而增加，有助於對抗通膨風險。其次，高收益債券市場的活躍，也顯示投資者對風險資產的胃納量增加，同時也可能是因為市場上尋求更高收益的資金充沛。這筆交易的巨大規模，部分原因在於該公司將現有成本較高的債務併入新的發行中，這是一種常見的債務管理策略。而擔保貸款憑證（CLOs）作為高收益浮動利率債券的主要買家，其市場的蓬勃發展也為這類債券提供了強勁的需求支撐。這對整個歐洲的金融市場，特別是高收益債券板塊，都具有重要的指標意義。

level3_translation.sentence: Assemblin Caverion on Sept. 16 priced the second-largest euro-denominated floating-rate note (FRN) ever sold by a European high yield borrower, after the Stockholm-based technical installations group upsized its planned seven-year deal to €1.53 billion.
level3_translation.translation: Assemblin Caverion這家總部位於斯德哥爾摩的技術安裝集團，在9月16日為其原定七年期的債券增額發行至15.3億歐元後，成功定價了歐洲高收益債券發行者有史以來第二大筆的歐元計價浮動利率債券（FRN）。

level3_translation.sentence: The bumper deal — which cleared at E+300, offered at par — is the largest euro FRN tranche since Wind Tre's record-breaking €2.25 billion deal back in 2017.
level3_translation.translation: 這筆超大額的交易——最終定價在歐洲銀行同業拆款利率（Euribor）加300個基點，並以面額發行——是自2017年Wind Tre創紀錄的22.5億歐元交易以來，規模最大的歐元浮動利率債券批次。

level3_translation.sentence: It tops a €1.375 billion Nexi bond from 2018 and a €1.25 billion trade from TeamSystem last year.
level3_translation.translation: 這筆交易超越了2018年Nexi發行的13.75億歐元債券，以及去年TeamSystem的12.5億歐元交易。

level3_translation.sentence: Big slateAssemblin Caverion's offering was also the largest in a €4.53 billion slate of high yield transactions to price on Sept. 16 — which according to LCD, represents the busiest day of the year so far in volume terms for the European primary high yield market, and the sixth-busiest on record.
level3_translation.translation: Assemblin Caverion的這筆發行，也是9月16日總計45.3億歐元高收益債券交易中規模最大的一筆——根據LCD的數據，這一天是今年迄今為止歐洲初級高收益市場交易量最繁忙的一天，也是有紀錄以來第六繁忙的日子。

level3_translation.sentence: The mammoth size of the new offering for Assemblin Caverion mainly reflects the fact that the group is effectively merging a higher-cost €780 million E+350 FRN into the new tranche, a strategy commonly used by high yield borrowers whose existing debt is already callable.
level3_translation.translation: Assemblin Caverion這筆新發行規模如此龐大，主要反映了該集團實際上是將一筆成本較高、7.8億歐元、定價在Euribor加350個基點的浮動利率債券，併入到新的債券批次中，這是一種高收益債券發行者常用來處理其現有可提前贖回債務的策略。

level3_translation.sentence: The deal, originally sized at €750 million, nevertheless reflects strong demand for floating-rate paper from an issuer that already has both fixed- and floating-rate debt in its structure.
level3_translation.translation: 儘管這筆交易最初規模預計為7.5億歐元，但最終結果仍反映出市場對這家發行者所發行的浮動利率債券有著強勁的需求，而該公司在其資本結構中原本就同時擁有固定利率和浮動利率債務。

level3_translation.sentence: "We were surprised seeing FRNs only, but it is the environment we prefer as an investor," said a manager at a high yield bond fund.
level3_translation.translation: 一位高收益債券基金經理表示：「我們很驚訝只看到浮動利率債券，但作為投資者，這正是我們偏好的市場環境。」

level3_translation.sentence: He also said the fund has increased its allocation to floating-rate debt from 15% to about 20% in recent weeks, and plans to increase this allocation to roughly a quarter of the portfolio.
level3_translation.translation: 他也提到，該基金近幾週已將浮動利率債務的配置比例從15%提高到約20%，並計劃將此配置進一步增加到投資組合的約四分之一。

level3_translation.sentence: FRN buyersThe creation of new European CLOs — the core buyers of high yield FRNs — has meanwhile remained robust this year, with new issuance running roughly in line with 2025's record volumes and new managers entering the market.
level3_translation.translation: 與此同時，作為高收益浮動利率債券核心買家的歐洲擔保貸款憑證（CLOs）今年持續強勁增長，新發行量大致與2025年的創紀錄水準持平，並且有新的基金經理進入市場。

level3_translation.sentence: While the number of warehouses open at any given time is difficult to quantify, speakers at S&P Global's European Structured Finance Conference in September put the number at 200.
level3_translation.translation: 雖然任何時候運作中的倉儲式融資工具（warehouses）數量難以量化，但標普全球（S&P Global）9月在歐洲結構性融資會議上的演講者指出，這個數字大約是200個。

level3_translation.sentence: Assemblin Caverion was formed in 2024 after Triton merged its technical installations company Assemblin with Caverion, the Finnish construction systems group which the private equity firm took private the prior year for €1.12 billion.
level3_translation.translation: Assemblin Caverion是在2024年成立的，當時Triton這家私募股權公司將其技術安裝公司Assemblin與芬蘭建築系統集團Caverion合併，而Triton在前一年以11.2億歐元將Caverion私有化。

level3_translation.sentence: The bond deal will support a dividend to Triton.
level3_translation.translation: 這筆債券交易將用於支付給Triton的股息。

english_professor_news.title: Corning Just Signed a Multibillion-Dollar Fiber Deal for AI and Broadband With Verizon. What That Means for GLW Stock.
english_professor_news.level1_blind:
Corning (GLW) is now home to another massive fiber deal. On Sept. 8, Verizon (VZ) struck a multibillion-dollar supply agreement with Corning for more than 80 million miles of high-density optical fiber and connectivity solutions through 2032. Fiber not only supports Verizon's broadband initiative but is needed for the construction of the long-haul, low-latency network necessary to link artificial intelligence (AI) data centers.

The timing is particularly fortuitous for Corning. The company already has a multibillion-dollar deal in place with Amazon (AMZN), as well as an initiative tied to Nvidia's (NVDA) AI infrastructure construction. Simply put, Corning is gaining traction in several different layers of the network, both inside and outside AI data centers.

Corning is a materials science corporation with its headquarters in Corning, New York. The company specializes in glass, ceramics, optical physics, and manufacturing. Corning offers its products in optical communications, mobile consumer electronics, displays, automotive, and other areas. Currently, Corning has a market capitalization of approximately $124 billion.

GLW stock currently trades near the $148 level. Although the stock is trading about 45% below its 52-week high of $271.78, shares still have appreciated about 70% year-to-date (YTD). This beats the S¼P 500 Index ($SPX) over the same period, which has gained roughly 11% so far in 2026. GLW stock has also almost doubled from its 52-week low of $77.05.

All this performance leaves Corning with a tough valuation profile. GLW stock trades at about 43.7 times forward earnings and 7.9 times sales. But there are some fundamental reasons behind this valuation premium, because Corning recently won another big customer. Indeed, the new agreement with Verizon comes after a multibillion-dollar contract with Amazon. The company also has a partnership with Nvidia for the expansion of U.S. optical connectivity manufacturing capacity by 10 times and fiber production capacity by more than 50%.

Corning pays a quarterly dividend of $0.28 per share, providing a yield of roughly 0.8% at the latest share price. The next dividend payment will be made on Sept. 29 to shareholders of record on Aug. 31.

Corning reported a strong second quarter. Core sales rose 17% year-over-year (YOY) to $4.74 billion, while core EPS jumped 30% to $0.78. Earnings beat the $0.76 consensus estimate, while revenue came in above the $4.63 billion forecast. On a GAAP basis, sales were $4.51 billion, and GAAP EPS rose 19% to $0.64.

Of course, what matters even more for the AI investment thesis is that Optical Communications sales grew 32% YOY to $2.07 billion in Q2. Within that, Enterprise Networks revenue skyrocketed 65%, “with Gen AI product sales growing significantly faster.” Core operating margin expanded by 190 basis points to 20.9%, while adjusted free cash flow stood at $1.42 billion.
